entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bohuslav, Count Chotek von Chotkow und Wognin was a Bohemian nobleman, landowner, and a diplomat in the service of Austria-Hungary. He was the father of Sophie, Duchess of Hohenberg, the morganatic wife of Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria.
